techniques.comment: The creation of a specialized agency to govern the autonomy: through the Little Russian Prikaz the tsarist government "exercised control over the political-administrative activity of the hetman's administration and the tsarist voivodes in Ukraine"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 6 2009) – the governance of the Hetmanate was embedded into Moscow's prikaz vertical.
